propositions: A single criterion's evidence run exhausting its step budget causes the entire bounded recovery to fail by propagating LLMBudgetExhaustedError out of the per-criterion loop, discarding all already-gathered evidence.

The per-criterion budget exhaustion should be treated as a safeguard on that criterion alone, not fatal to aggregate recovery; partial evidence must be preserved and the finalizer should render per-criterion verdicts with unverifiable-within-bounds marking.

When any evidence run raises LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, or token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError, a content-free exhausted placeholder entry must be substituted and recovery must continue with remaining criteria.
Recovery must fail outright only when EVERY criterion's evidence run fails; otherwise the finalizer receives N evidence entries (with exhausted ones marked) and produces a structured verdict.

Token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError from evidence runs must be caught and converted to the exhausted placeholder (mirroring the primary run path), while non-token UnretryableOutputError still propagates.
Successful-evidence recovery behavior must remain byte-identical: runs where no evidence agent fails must produce the same finalizer input as before the fix.
